name: Gift tax: a sibling and a parent
workings: From a sister (class II, 20,000): 80,000 in the band up to 300,000, 20% = 16,000; above the 75,000 limit the relief caps it at 15% × 75,000 + half of 5,000 = 13,750
To a parent (from a child) as a gift: class II, 20,000 (an inheritance would be class I, 100,000): 30,000 × 15% = 4,500
